sentences.text: Dialister hominis was described from an obligately anaerobic, Gram-stain-negative rod or coccobacillus isolated from a faecal sample of a healthy Japanese woman.
In co-culture it grew noticeably better with the gut commensal Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron, and adding one percent succinate improved its growth in broth.
An exploratory longitudinal study of sport participation reported study-group differences in Dialister hominis.
